description:
It’s her! Shy, violent, indecent her! After yet another day of getting told off, me, the hopeless theatrical aspirant, came home to a strange girl swearing next door. The sight of her beating the daylights out of some guy… She’s basically a mobster, I should be careful… Just my luck, having someone like her move in next door… I should avoid her at all costs… But the next day, she kissed me. …What is this girl?!
